description: Conformance vectors for H6008 over ble. Every SDK — the Rust core, its bindings and any hand-written port — must produce exactly these bytes for these arguments. The wire carries no envelope here, so a vector states `frames_hex` and no `message`. These frames are the host colour channel: they are short and their last byte is a sum, not the XOR the 20-byte frames carry. See ../README.md.

vectors.name: colour, cold white
vectors.source: captured, tests/fixtures/ble-captures/H6008/color.txt — the unit rendered a cold white

vectors.name: colour, dark. The bulb stays on and renders nothing
vectors.source: captured, tests/fixtures/ble-captures/H6008/color.txt — the unit went dark and read back on over lan
